messages.subject_clean: Reminder: Seminal Ideas & Controversies in Statistics
messages.body_plain:
Hello R-SIG-EPI members

A reminder - Analytical choices in epidemiology carry assumptions that deserve attention alongside the code used. Seminal Ideas & Controversies in Statistics: A Short Course is a 2-day seminar livestreaming November 3?4 with Roderick Little (Department of Biostatistics, University of Michigan). Likelihood inference and generalized estimating equations offer different approaches to analysing correlated data. Epidemiologists using R can draw on the comparison when choosing and explaining methods for longitudinal studies. The discussion of probability sampling and randomized trials also connects statistical inference with study design.

Details and registration: https://instats.org/seminar/seminal-ideas-and-controversies-in-stati-2
The seminar page includes the full schedule and registration details.


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
Director and Co-founder
Instats | instats.org
